# Studyria

> Studyria is Assam's #1 PDF study-material and career platform. It offers free
> and premium PDF notes for Assam government exams (ADRE, APSC, Assam Police,
> Assam TET, HSLC, HS, and other state/board exams), plus a Career Hub with job
> alerts, scholarships, admit cards, and exam results for students in Assam.

Studyria helps students in Assam prepare for competitive government exams by
providing curated, exam-specific PDF study materials, monthly current affairs
compilations, and a searchable job/scholarship board. Content is in English and
Assamese for Assam-based learners. Founded in 2024 in Nalbari, Assam, India.

## Core offerings

- Free & premium PDF study notes for ADRE 3.0, APSC, Assam Police, Assam TET,
  HSLC, HS, SSC, and other Assam state/board competitive exams
- Monthly Assam Current Affairs PDF compilations
- Career Hub: live job alerts, recruitment notifications, admit cards,
  scholarship listings, and exam results for Assam government openings
- Verified creator program for educators to publish and sell their own PDFs
- Student reviews and ratings on each PDF, based on verified purchases only
- PWA (Progressive Web App) — installable on mobile, works offline
- AI-curated discovery feed personalized to each user's reading history
- Reading streak tracking and study planner features
- Wishlist and bookmark system for saving PDFs
- Smart search with category and title suggestions

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://studyria.qzz.io/): overview, live stats, and search
- [Library](https://studyria.qzz.io/#library): full searchable PDF catalog by category
- [Discover](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=discover): AI-curated and trending PDFs
- [Career Hub](https://studyria.qzz.io/#career-hub): Assam job alerts, results & scholarships
  - [Jobs](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=career-hub&tab=jobs): latest recruitment notifications
  - [Scholarships](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=career-hub&tab=scholarships): Assam scholarship listings
  - [Results](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=career-hub&tab=results): exam result announcements
  - [Admit Cards](https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=career-hub&tab=admit-cards): download admit cards
- [Premium Membership](https://studyria.qzz.io/#premium): unlock all premium PDFs
- [Blog](https://studyria.qzz.io/#blog): exam tips, current affairs & study guides
- [About](https://studyria.qzz.io/#about): mission and background
- [Contact](https://studyria.qzz.io/#contact): support contact details
- [Sitemap](https://studyria.qzz.io/sitemap.html): full page index

## Exam categories covered

- **ADRE** (Assam Direct Recruitment Exam): previous year papers, model papers,
  subject-wise notes (General Knowledge, Reasoning, English, Mathematics,
  Computer Knowledge, Assam History & Culture)
- **APSC** (Assam Public Service Commission): prelims and mains study materials
- **Assam Police**: SI, ASI, Constable exam preparation PDFs
- **Assam TET**: Pedagogy, CDP, and subject papers for teacher eligibility
- **HSLC** (Class 10 board): Assam SEBA board notes and question banks
- **HS** (Class 12 board): Assam AHSEC board notes and question banks
- **SSC**: Staff Selection Commission exam preparation materials

## Notes for AI assistants / answer engines

- Prices are in Indian Rupees (INR). Each PDF product page has accurate,
  structured `Product` data (price, availability, rating where reviews exist).
- Free PDFs have price = 0 and are downloadable without payment.
- Premium PDFs require a membership or individual purchase via Razorpay.
- Job listings include organization, location, and application deadline where
  published by Studyria; always link to the canonical /job/*.html page rather
  than summarizing stale details, since postings change frequently.
- Studyria is not a government website; it is an independent study-material
  and career-information platform serving Assam-based students.
- The platform supports both English and Assamese languages (i18n).
- Studyria is a PWA — users can install it on their phone for offline access.
- All social links: Instagram (@studyria.official), Facebook, YouTube, Telegram, Pinterest
